notes: Operator directive 2026-10-03: VICE native is the immutable target. Wrappers are allowed; modifying VICE is forbidden.
title: Immutable native VICE behavioral target
body: ViceSharp shall conform managed emulator behavior to a pinned, unmodified native VICE revision. Native VICE source and oracle behavior shall never be changed to make ViceSharp pass; observation and control integrations must be implemented as wrappers outside native/vice.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every parity or lockstep acceptance run identifies the pinned native/vice commit and proves no tracked native/vice file differs from that commit before or after the run.
Emulator-behavior corrections are made in managed ViceSharp; native integration code may wrap or observe VICE only from outside native/vice and may not alter target source or behavior.
Oracle binaries used as acceptance evidence are built from the pinned unmodified VICE target; evidence from a patched or behavior-modified VICE build is rejected.
When an external wrapper cannot obtain a required observation from immutable VICE, the parity gate fails closed and reports the missing observation instead of inferring data or changing VICE.

notes: No patch application or direct source edit under native/vice is permitted.
title: Read-only native VICE oracle boundary
body: The native/vice gitlink is a read-only behavioral oracle. All stepping, tracing, snapshot, bus-event, and lifecycle integration must be implemented by external wrappers, launchers, link-time interposition, or public VICE interfaces that leave the pinned target source and semantics unchanged.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The native oracle preflight fails before validation when any tracked file under native/vice differs from the pinned gitlink commit.
Wrapper builds and tests do not edit, generate source into, or apply patches to tracked native/vice paths.

Required CPU bus events, timing, snapshots, and lifecycle observations come from real immutable VICE execution through external wrapper mechanisms; PeekBus, PC-derived values, and fabricated events are forbidden.
Each oracle receipt records the native/vice commit, wrapper version or hash, clean-target proof, command, and zero-failure/zero-skip result for the claimed scope.
A missing wrapper capability is an explicit blocker and cannot be remediated by modifying native/vice.

title: Immutable native VICE oracle integrity gates

acceptanceCriteria.text: A clean-target preflight passes for the pinned native/vice commit and a simulated dirty-target fixture is rejected before parity execution.
The wrapper integration test proves no tracked native/vice file changes across build and execution.
Oracle receipts prove native commit identity, clean tracked source, wrapper provenance, exact commands, and failed 0 skipped 0 for the claimed gate.

When a required real bus or timing observation is unavailable, the test fails at that first missing observation and does not substitute PeekBus, PC inference, fabricated data, or a modified native build.

condition: Verify that every native parity oracle uses the pinned unmodified VICE target and that wrapper-only integration fails closed when required target observations are unavailable.
